Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In continuation to our letter dated July 10, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of the SEBI Listing 
Regulations, we hereby inform you that the audio recording of the Conference Call held today i.e. 
Thursday, July 16, 2026 at 4:30 PM (IST) on the Company’s financial performance for the  quarter ended 
June 30, 2026 has been uploaded on the Company’s website within the stipulated timelines at 
https://www.dbcorpltd.com/financial-results.php. 
 
The link to access the said audio recording is: 
https://dbcorpltd.com/img/DB_Corp_Q1FY27_Earnings_Call_Audio.mp3.  
 
Request you to kindly take the above on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
For D.B. Corp Limited
